reasoning_content: The dex login form has `login` and `password` fields, and its action is `/dex/auth/local/login?back=&state=...`. There's no visible CSRF hidden input. The Dex form might be using a CSRF token in a different way. I'll check whether there are any hidden inputs at all.

action.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
grep -o '<input[^>]*type="hidden"[^>]*>' dex_auth2.html || echo "no hidden inputs"
# Check for CSRF in page
grep -io 'csrf[^"]*' dex_auth2.html | head -3 || true
